extracted.intended_audience: Legal practitioners, HUD program staff, regulated entities, and members of the public seeking HUD regulations
extracted.subtask_short: HUD Title 24 eCFR table of contents
extracted.subtask_description: Index and navigation page for Title 24 of the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (HUD regulations), listing parts, chapters, and providing basic explanatory notes about the eCFR and site feedback mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal status of the CFR and eCFR
rubrics_metrics.description: The Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) is the official legal print publication containing the codification of general and permanent rules published in the Federal Register. The Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR) is a continuously updated online version of the CFR and is not an official legal edition of the CFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users are directed to view the most recent official published edition on govinfo.gov. The page points to explanatory material ('Learn more') about the eCFR's status and the editorial process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site feedback and content feedback procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for providing feedback about the www.ecfr.gov website versus the substantive content: use 'Website Feedback' for site issues, and 'Content Feedback' for instructions on contacting the issuing agency about content. For questions to the issuing agency, contact the agency directly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office of the Federal Register publishes documents on behalf of Federal agencies but does not have authority over the agencies' programs; the page recommends contacting the relevant agency directly regarding substantive program content. This guidance distinguishes technical/site feedback from regulatory/substantive queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and organization of Title 24 (Table of Contents)
rubrics_metrics.description: An itemized listing of Title 24 (Housing and Urban Development) parts and chapters, showing parts (e.g., Part 0 Standards of Conduct; Part 1 Nondiscrimination in Federally Assisted Programs; Parts 35, 40, 50, etc.), chapters (I, II, III, etc.), and subtitle breakdowns (Subtitle A Office of the Secretary; Subtitle B Regulations Relating to HUD). It notes page ranges for parts/sections (e.g., 1.1–1.10, 8.1–8.58).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listing is intended to help users navigate by entering citations or headings; it includes links to view historical versions, recent changes, and the ability to switch to a drafting site. It also flags that Title 24 is displayed 'up to date as of 5/07/2026' and notes the last amendment date.
